results.title: Stock Market Today (May 7, 2026): Nasdaq falls into decline as tech strength cools intraday
results.summary: Nasdaq declined 0.13%, S&P 500 fell 0.38%, Russell 2000 dropped 1.74%, Dow declined 0.63%. Stocks fell after hitting new all-time intraday highs as oil prices came back from losses, traders eyeing Iran peace deal developments. Nvidia, Microsoft, Tesla each gained more than 1%.

results.title: Stock Market Today (May 6, 2026): Nasdaq rises 2%, Russell 2000 and S&P 500 set new record
results.summary: S&P 500 advanced 1.46% to 7,365.12, Nasdaq gained 2.02% to 25,838.94. Semiconductor names rallied after Supermicro and AMD reported strong earnings.
